8170-gargantua-and-pantagruel-illustrate.creator: Unknown

arxiv-1907-10111.title: Measure of not-completely-positive qubit maps: the general case
arxiv-1907-10111.creator: Vinayak Jagadish, R. Srikanth, Francesco Petruccione
arxiv-1907-10111.description: Abstract We show that the set of not-completely-positive (NCP) maps is unbounded, unless further assumptions are made. This is done by first proposing a reasonable definition of a valid NCP map, which is nontrivial because NCP maps may lack a full positivity domain. The definition is motivated by specific examples.

arxiv-2001-08318.title: Consistent Discretization of a Class of Predefined-Time Stable Systems This work has been submitted to IFAC for possible publication
arxiv-2001-08318.creator: Esteban Jiménez-Rodríguez, Rodrigo Aldana-López, Juan D. Sánchez-Torres, David Gómez-Gutiérrez, Alexander G. Loukianov
arxiv-2001-08318.description: Abstract As the main contribution, this document provides a consistent discretization of a class of fixed-time stable systems, namely predefined-time stable systems. In the unperturbed case, the proposed approach allows obtaining not only a consistent but exact discretization of the considered class of predefined-time stable systems, whereas in the perturbed case, the consistent discretization preserves the predefined-time stability property.

arxiv-2006-15232.title: The classification of symmetry protected topological phases of one-dimensional fermion systems
arxiv-2006-15232.creator: C. Bourne, Y. Ogata
arxiv-2006-15232.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by C. Bourne, Y. Ogata. We introduce an index for symmetry protected topological (SPT) phases of infinite fermionic chains with an on-site symmetry given by a finite group G G . This index takes values in ℤ 2 × H 1 ​ ( G , ℤ 2 ) × H 2 ​ ( G , U ​ ( 1 ) 𝔭 ) \mathbb{Z}_{2}\times H^{1}(G,\mathbb{Z}_{2})\times H^{2}(G,U(1)_{\mathfrak{p}}) with a generalized Wall group law under stacking.

arxiv-2011-07279.title: Towards Zero-Shot Learning with Fewer Seen Class Examples
arxiv-2011-07279.creator: Vinay Kumar Verma Ashish Mishra Anubha Pandey, Hema A. Murthy Piyush Rai
arxiv-2011-07279.description: Abstract We present a meta-learning based generative model for zero-shot learning (ZSL) towards a challenging setting when the number of training examples from each seen class is very few. This setup contrasts with the conventional ZSL approaches, where training typically assumes the availability of a sufficiently large number of training examples from each of the seen classes.

arxiv-2102-01816.title: Classical solutions for fractional porous medium flow
arxiv-2102-01816.creator: Young-Pil Choi, In-Jee Jeong
arxiv-2102-01816.description: Abstract We consider the fractional porous medium flow introduced by Caffarelli and Vazquez ( [ 3 ] ) and obtain local in time existence, uniqueness, and blow-up criterion for smooth solutions. The proof is based on establishing a commutator estimate involving fractional Laplacian operators. 1 Introduction 1.

arxiv-2102-08482.title: Finding the Ground-Truth from Multiple Labellers: Why Parameters of the Task Matter
arxiv-2102-08482.creator: Robert McCluskey, Amir Enshaei, Bashar Awwad Shiekh Hasan
arxiv-2102-08482.description: Abstract Employing multiple workers to label data for machine learning models has become increasingly important in recent years with greater demand to collect huge volumes of labelled data to train complex models while mitigating the risk of incorrect and noisy labelling.

arxiv-2104-02095.title: Analytic function approximation by path norm regularized deep networks
arxiv-2104-02095.description: Abstract We show that neural networks with absolute value activation function and with the path norm, the depth, the width and the network weights having logarithmic dependence on 1 / ε 1/\varepsilon can ε \varepsilon -approximate functions that are analytic on certain regions of ℂ d \mathbb{C}^{d} .

arxiv-2211-08342.title: A positive cosmological constant as a geometrical artifact
arxiv-2211-08342.creator: Pantelis S. Apostolopoulos, Christos Tsipogiannis
arxiv-2211-08342.description: Abstract We revisit the classical mechanism to produce d − d- dimensional spacetimes via Kaluza-Klein compactification. We made the assumption that the ( d + 1 ) − \left(d+1\right)- dimensional bulk geometry ℳ \mathcal{M} admits a Homothetic Vector Field (HVF) 𝐇 \mathbf{H} relaxing the existence of a zero i.e.

arxiv-2304-12845.title: (Local) Differential Privacy has NO Disparate Impact on Fairness Thanks: Version of Record (DBSec’23): https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-031-37586-6_1 . Affiliation: Inria and École Polytechnique (IPP), Palaiseau, France
arxiv-2304-12845.creator: Héber H. Arcolezi, Karima Makhlouf, Catuscia Palamidessi
arxiv-2304-12845.description: Abstract In recent years, Local Differential Privacy (LDP), a robust privacy-preserving methodology, has gained widespread adoption in real-world applications. With LDP, users can perturb their data on their devices before sending it out for analysis. However, as the collection of multiple sensitive information becomes more prevalent across various industries, collecting a single sensitive attribute under LDP may not be sufficient.

arxiv-2405-17884.title: On basic velocity estimates for the plane steady-state Navier–Stokes system and its applications
arxiv-2405-17884.creator: Mikhail Korobkov, Xiao Ren
arxiv-2405-17884.description: Abstract We consider some new estimates for general steady Navier-Stokes solutions in plane domains. According to our main result, if the domain is convex, then the difference between mean values of the velocity over two concentric circles is bounded (up to a constant factor) by the square-root of the Dirichlet integral in the annulus between the circles.

arxiv-2408-12415.title: A manifold learning approach to nonlinear model order reduction of quasi-static problems in solid mechanics
arxiv-2408-12415.creator: Lisa Scheunemann, Erik Faust
arxiv-2408-12415.description: Abstract The proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) – a popular projection-based model order reduction (MOR) method – may require significant model dimensionalities to successfully capture a nonlinear solution manifold resulting from a parameterised quasi-static solid-mechanical problem. The local basis method by Amsallem et al.

arxiv-2410-00437.title: The space of homogeneous preserving semistar operations on graded domains
arxiv-2410-00437.creator: Parviz Sahandi
arxiv-2410-00437.description: Abstract . Let R = ⨁ α ∈ Γ R α R=\bigoplus_{\alpha\in\Gamma}R_{\alpha} be a graded integral domain. In this paper we study the space of homogeneous preserving semistar operations on R R . We show if ⋆ \star is a homogeneous preserving semistar operation on R R , then ⋆ a \star_{a} is also homogeneous preserving.

arxiv-2504-07751.title: Topological laser in a two-dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger lattice with artificial gauge flux
arxiv-2504-07751.creator: Yi-Ling Zhang, Yang Liu, Zhi-Kang Lin, Jian-Hua Jiang
arxiv-2504-07751.description: Abstract Topological lasers, known for their robustness and unique features originating from nontrivial topology, have recently become a focal point of research in photonics. In this work, we propose a topological laser based on two-dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger photonic lattices as induced by artificial gauge flux insertion.

arxiv-2507-23260.title: Superconducting coherence boosted by outer-layer metallic screening in multilayered cuprates
arxiv-2507-23260.creator: Junhyeok Jeong, Kifu Kurokawa, Shiro Sakai, Tomotaka Nakayama, Kotaro Ando, Naoshi Ogane, Soonsang Huh, Matthew D. Watson, Timur K. Kim, Cephise Cacho, Chun Lin, Makoto Hashimoto, Donghui Lu, Takami Tohyama, Kazuyasu Tokiwa, Takeshi Kondo

A 2025 arXiv research paper by Junhyeok Jeong, Kifu Kurokawa, Shiro Sakai, Tomotaka Nakayama, Kotaro Ando, Naoshi Ogane, Soonsang Huh, Matthew D. Watson, Timur K. Kim, Cephise Cacho, Chun Lin, Makoto Hashimoto, Donghui Lu, Takami Tohyama, Kazuyasu Tokiwa, Takeshi Kondo. In multilayered high-

arxiv-2509-19982.title: Dark Matter and Electroweak Baryogenesis with Spontaneous C ​ P CP Violation in the Early Universe
arxiv-2509-19982.creator: Subhojit Roy
arxiv-2509-19982.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Subhojit Roy. Dark matter (DM) and the baryon asymmetry of the universe (BAU) are among the most compelling indications of physics beyond the Standard Model. We revisit the inelastic Higgs-portal complex singlet, a minimal framework in which a complex scalar splits into two nearly degenerate real states, with an off-diagonal Higgs-portal interaction that drives coannihilation to set the relic density, while the elastic DM-Higgs coupling can be tuned small enough to evade direct-detection limits.

pmc-10650846.title: The Reactions of Alkenes with Phenyl-N-triflylimino-λ3-iodane: Solvent and Oxidant Impact
pmc-10650846.creator: Mikhail Yu Moskalik, Anton S Ganin, Bagrat A Shainyan, David StC Black
pmc-10650846.description: The reactions of alkenes with phenyl-N-triflylimino-λ3-iodane PhI=NTf (1) have been studied in different conditions. In methylene chloride, in the presence of N-halosuccinimides, the products of mono and bis-triflamidation were obtained. In MeCN, the product of bromotriflamidation (with NBS) with solvent interception or of bis-triflamidation (with NIS) is formed.

pmc-11353306.title: New Quantum Private Comparison Using Bell States
pmc-11353306.creator: Min Hou, Yue Wu
pmc-11353306.description: Quantum private comparison (QPC) represents a cryptographic approach that enables two parties to determine whether their confidential data are equivalent, without disclosing the actual values. Most existing QPC protocols utilizing single photons or Bell states are considered highly feasible, but they suffer from inefficiency.

pmc-11495424.title: Incongruent Treatment Recommendations Between Left and Right Hip Bone Mineral Densities
pmc-11495424.creator: Abhilasha Singh, Anu Sharma
pmc-11495424.description: ObjectiveThe official position of the International Society for Clinical Densitometry (ISCD) is that either hip site can be scanned with dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA) imaging. Whether there is a difference in guideline-based treatment recommendations between hip sites has not previously been assessed.

pmc-11605470.title: A first case of subdural empyema due to Staphylococcus saccharolyticus
pmc-11605470.creator: Masahiko Kaneko, Tomoki Shinohara, Yuya Masuda, Kenichi Ishikawa, Hisaharu Shikata, Chie Sakisuka, Daisuke Syoda, Akira Fukui, Kiichirou Zenke
pmc-11605470.description: Staphylococcus saccharolyticus, an anaerobic coagulase-negative staphylococcal species, is a member of the normal skin microbiota. It can be a rare cause of human infectious disease and is usually considered a contaminant, but some rare reports have described deep-seated infections caused by S. saccharolyticus.

pmc-12466887.title: Hydrogen Sulfide Deficiency Contributes to Tubular Damage and Calcium Oxalate Crystal Formation in Hyperoxaluria Nephropathy: Role of Osteopontin and Tamm–Horsfall Protein
pmc-12466887.creator: Chien-Lin Lu, Yi-Shiou Tseng, Wen-Bin Wu, Chun-Hou Liao, Ming-Chieh Ma
pmc-12466887.description: Hydrogen sulfide (H2S) exerts regulatory functions in kidney diseases. However, its protective role against kidney stone formation remains unclear. Here, we demonstrate that hyperoxaluria or oxalate exposure impairs H2S formation, leading to tubular injury and calcium oxalate (CaOx) crystal deposition in both in vivo and in vitro models.

pmc-12508538.title: Impact of diabetes-specific nutrition formulas on time in range in overweight or obese Colombian patients with diabetes: A case series study
pmc-12508538.creator: Ana-M Gomez, Maria-P Chicue, Diana-C Henao, Oscar-M Muñoz-Velandia
pmc-12508538.description: The use of diabetes-specific nutrition formulas reduces postprandial glucose and insulin levels and promotes satiety, thereby improving glycemic control and contributing to weight loss. The effect of diabetes-specific nutrition formulas on the percentage of time in range (70–180 mg/dL) has not yet been investigated.

pmc-12522945.title: Choosing regional, rural, and remote practice: what attracts or deters early-career doctors?
pmc-12522945.creator: Sonia Minooee, Susan Wright, Torres Woolley
pmc-12522945.description: BackgroundEnhancing the retention of medical professionals in regional, rural and remote (RRR) areas requires a multi-faceted strategy that acknowledges and addresses the contextual barriers doctors face when deciding whether to continue practising in RRR hospitals. Gaining a deeper understanding of these factors can inform evidence-based workforce planning and policy development to mitigate the rural physician shortage across Australia.

pmc-12587845.title: Efficacy and Safety of Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography for the Longevous Population
pmc-12587845.creator: Jin-Li He, Liang Zhu, Zhen-Zhen Yang, Jun-Bo Hong, Ya-Wei Xing, Shi-Yu Zhang, You-Hua Wang, Yun-Wu Wang, Xiao-Dong Zhou, Xiao-Jiang Zhou, Guo-Hua Li, Yin Zhu, You-Xiang Chen
pmc-12587845.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThere are presently limited clinical studies of endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) in the longevous (elders aged no less than 90 years old). This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of ERCP in longevous patients.MethodsA total of 113 longevous patients who underwent ERCP for the first time at our center from January 8th, 2009 to December 20th, 2023 were enrolled. Correspondingly, the control groups included the old-old (75–89 years) patient group and the young-old (60–74 years) patient group.

pmc-12606195.title: Enhancing recombinant thaumatin production by Komagataella phaffii through cold atmospheric helium plasma jet
pmc-12606195.creator: Nivedita Parsekar, Simen Akkermans, Dmytro Kozak, Jan F M Van Impe
pmc-12606195.description: Cold atmospheric plasma is emerging as a non-thermal and non-invasive tool for influencing microbial metabolism by modifying bioreactor conditions. This paper validates the effect of a cold atmospheric helium plasma jet on recombinant thaumatin bioproduction by genetically modified Komagataella phaffii. The yeast produced recombinant thaumatin with methanol serving as the carbon and energy source.

pmc-12711435.title: Improved Prediction of Eurasian Beaver Gnawing Preferences in Riparian Habitats: A Machine Learning Approach
pmc-12711435.creator: Giovanni Trentanovi, Emanuele Santi, Emiliano Mori, Andrea Viviano, Alessio Giovannelli, Maria Laura Traversi, Francesco Sarnari
pmc-12711435.description: In this study, we investigated the impact of Eurasian beavers ( Castor fiber Linnaeus, 1758) on riparian woodlands in Central Italy using Machine Learning (ML) techniques. Beavers are ecosystem engineers who may modify riverine ecosystems through dam building and foraging activities. Their gnawing activity can significantly alter the composition and structure of riparian forests.

pmc-12978933.title: Artificial Intelligence for Medicines Information: Scoping Review of Clinical Applications and Digital Health Inequalities
pmc-12978933.creator: Shahd Al-Arkee, Josephine Falade, Vibhu Paudyal, Andrew Coristine, Taiane de Azevedo Cardoso
pmc-12978933.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundArtificial intelligence (AI) has the potential to support medicines information services. However, a comprehensive mapping of its use, particularly within pharmacy practice and in the context of digital health inequalities, is lacking.ObjectiveThis scoping review mapped existing evidence on AI-driven medicines information, focusing on the accuracy and completeness of AI-generated content, the role of health care professionals (HCPs), particularly pharmacists, and the impact of digital health inequalities on AI adoption.MethodsThis scoping review was informed by the methodological framework proposed by Levac et al,

pmc-13008514.title: Aortic Root Thrombosis in LVAD Patients
pmc-13008514.creator: Adhvithi Pingili, Tarun Dalia
pmc-13008514.description: Corresponding AuthorKey words: aortic root thrombosis, aspiration thrombectomy, LVAD, management We read about this interesting case of aortic root thrombus (ART) management by Dr Kazem et al1 with great enthusiasm. ART is an uncommon yet underrecognized complication in patients with continuous-flow left ventricular assist devices (LVAD).

pmc-13226783.title: Knee dislocation associated with patellar tendon rupture: case report and literature review
pmc-13226783.creator: Jorge Isla, Rafael Calvo, Héctor Cifuentes, Consuelo Carrasco, Waldo González, Manuel Terraza, Hernán Salas
pmc-13226783.description: Knee dislocations and multiligament knee injuries represent a significant clinical and surgical challenge, particularly when associated with patellar tendon rupture, a rare combination with a high functional impact that may initially go unrecognized.Management of these injuries requires meticulous planning to restore anatomy, joint stability, and extensor mechanism function in order to optimize long-term functional outcomes.

pmc-13514219.title: Visual Attention and Strategic Sophistication in the Strategic Environment Effect: An Eye-Tracking Approach
pmc-13514219.creator: Yukihiko Funaki, Yukio Koriyama, Ayano Nakagawa, Ali I. Ozkes
pmc-13514219.description: This study investigates how strategic environments shape a decision maker’s reasoning processes by incorporating visual attention and cognitive engagement. Using eye-tracking methods within experimental guessing games featuring interior equilibria, we analyze how strategic complementarity and substitutability alter choice behavior and cognitive engagement.

pmc-13565448.title: Postnatal Development of Prospective Beef Bulls: Integrating Nutrition, Metabolism, Endocrine Regulation, and Breeding Soundness
pmc-13565448.creator: Borhan Shokrollahi, Jae-Yong Choi, Sang-Min Shin, Seung-Eun Lee, Miyoung Won
pmc-13565448.description: Simple SummaryThe development of future beef breeding bulls begins long before they produce semen or enter breeding programs. Nutrition, growth, metabolism, hormones, and body development work together from birth to determine whether a young bull will become a healthy and fertile breeding animal.

pmc-13623601.title: Multi-omics and experimental validation reveal ISG20L2 as a potential pro-oncogenic regulator in gastric cancer
pmc-13623601.creator: Song Liang, Chuanjun Wang, Yongkang Liang, Chuansi Wang, Xiuming Lu, Shenwei Wu, Changyu He, Weiwei Yuan
pmc-13623601.description: BackgroundGastric cancer is a major malignancy with molecular heterogeneity and limited biomarkers for risk stratification and therapeutic guidance. Interferon-stimulated 20 kDa exonuclease-like 2 (ISG20L2), a regulator of ribosome biogenesis, has been implicated in tumor progression, but its relevance in gastric cancer is poorly defined. This study aimed to characterize the potential pro-oncogenic and immune relevance of ISG20L2 in gastric cancer.

pmc-13678616.title: iEvac-Z, an Inactivated Ebola Vaccine: Phase 1 Trial in Japan
pmc-13678616.creator: Tokiko Watanabe, Michiko Koga, Masanori Nojima, Minako Kono, Yuriko Tomita, Tadashi Maemura, Itsuki Anzai, Yuri Furusawa, Calvin Duong, Yoichiro Kino, Peter J. Halfmann, Fumitaka Nagamura, Hiroshi Yotsuyanagi, Yoshihiro Kawaoka
pmc-13678616.description: sed Ebola vaccines, while effective, raise safety concerns due to their replication-competent nature and associated adverse events 2,3. We developed iEvac-Z, an inactivated whole-virus Ebola vaccine derived from replication-deficient Ebola virus lacking the essential VP30 gene (EBOVΔVP30) 4. This virus cannot replicate outside VP30-complementing cells and can be manufactured under biosafety level 2 conditions.
